import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('"'"'/home/zhengliang01/scheduleurm_work/CFCMT_RESULTS/tsc_v86r82_external_v9_interference_aware_redevelopment_20260830/interference_redevelopment_v1'"'"')
scenario=root/"jinan"/"jinan_3x4_real"
def load(seed,policy):
    return json.loads((scenario/f"seed_{seed}"/policy/"result.json").read_text())
def accepted(result):
    out=[]
    for row in result["metrics"]["accepted_intervention_trace"]:
        if not row.get("request_accepted"): continue
        origin=row.get("target_originator") or {}
        out.append({
          "key":(float(row["time_sec"]),str(row["tls_id"]),str(row["selected_phase_state"])),
          "time":float(row["time_sec"]),"tls":str(row["tls_id"]),
          "priority":float(row.get("priority",0.0)),
          "upper":float(origin.get("predicted_upper",0.0)),
          "delta":float(origin.get("predicted_delta",0.0)),
          "trust":float(origin.get("context_trust",0.0)),
          "queue":float(row.get("total_queue",0.0)),
          "vehicles":float(row.get("total_vehicles",0.0)),
        })
    return out
seeds=sorted(int(p.name.split("_")[1]) for p in scenario.glob("seed_*"))
rows=[]
for seed in seeds:
    b=load(seed,"phase_pressure"); g=load(seed,"uh_global_h120_m1"); l=load(seed,"uh_local_h120_m1")
    ga=accepted(g); la=accepted(l)
    gmap={x["key"]:x for x in ga}; lmap={x["key"]:x for x in la}
    go=[v for k,v in gmap.items() if k not in lmap]
    lo=[v for k,v in lmap.items() if k not in gmap]
    if not go and not lo: continue
    bw=float(b["metrics"]["mean_tripinfo_waiting_time"])
    first=min([x["time"] for x in go+lo])
    rows.append({
      "seed":seed,"first_divergence_sec":first,
      "global_actions":len(ga),"local_actions":len(la),
      "global_only":go,"local_only":lo,
      "global_delta_pct":100*(float(g["metrics"]["mean_tripinfo_waiting_time"])-bw)/bw,
      "local_delta_pct":100*(float(l["metrics"]["mean_tripinfo_waiting_time"])-bw)/bw,
      "baseline_collision":int(b["metrics"]["collision_incidents"]),
      "global_collision":int(g["metrics"]["collision_incidents"]),
      "local_collision":int(l["metrics"]["collision_incidents"]),
    })
print(json.dumps({"differing_seed_count":len(rows),"rows":rows},sort_keys=True))
